meta.title: RFQ to Auction Conversion: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and as a Buyer on the same tenant to compare conversion availability
Verify or record whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants conversion to additional roles
Assert the non-Buyer conversion refusal/absence and the Buyer conversion success as a role-controlled comparison
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and as a Buyer on the same tenant to compare conversion availability; Verify or record whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants conversion to additional roles; Assert the non-Buyer conversion refusal/absence and the Buyer conversion success as a role-controlled comparison

steps.note: Open an existing RFQ event to provide the starting point for the conversion check.

args.need: sign in as the non-Buyer user and the Buyer user on the same tenant, try RFQ-to-Auction conversion for each, and report whether the action is refused, absent, or succeeds, including any RBAC configuration that grants it to other roles

steps.note: The required comparison depends on separate user roles and tenant permissions that the catalog cannot provision or switch between.
Check that the final tester-performed Buyer conversion state did not show an application error.
